question: A prism separates white light into colours, while a polaroid changes the intensity of transmitted light depending on its orientation. Explain the different wave properties involved in these two observations.

options.A: A prism demonstrates polarisation based on transverse vibrations, while a polaroid demonstrates dispersion based on refractive index.
options.B: Both elements demonstrate the longitudinal wave property of light under different thermal states.
options.C: A prism demonstrates dispersion because different wavelengths experience different refractive indices, while a polaroid demonstrates polarisation due to the transverse nature of light.
options.D: A prism filters light by absorbing specific wavelengths, while a polaroid shifts the wavelength of light via refraction.
